yield10y.note: yield up = discount rate up = long-duration assets reprice lower

vol.note: MOVE up = rate vol up = bond market unsettled, distinct from equity fear

diagnosis.explanation: Signals are mixed; no single-factor explanation holds.
what_the_data_actually_shows: Equities ROSE 2.59% over five sessions while crypto moved -9.19% - this is not a broad risk-off event.
High-yield credit was essentially flat (-0.38%), so there is no credit stress signal. A borrower struggling to place debt at an acceptable price is a pricing standoff, not default fear.
Long Treasuries moved -3.1% while the 10y yield rose - duration is being repriced.
The 10y yield is up 1.01pp over one year (4.15% to 5.15%), which is the dominant discount-rate story. This dwarfs the 0.2pp move since the election.

Inside AI, the vertically-integrated names and the datacenter/power complex diverged sharply over five sessions. WHY they diverged is not observable in price data - capital rotation, an NVDA-specific event, or export-control news would all look identical here. Treat rotation as a hypothesis, not a finding.
diagnosis.time_scale_warning: The 1y yield change and the 5-day equity divergence are different horizons. The yield did not move 1pp in five sessions, so the rate story cannot explain a five-day cross-sectional split. Do not let a one-year explanation stand in for a five-day one.
diagnosis.implication: The QTS story is a useful signal about primary-market pricing power, but the data does not show a credit event. It shows an elevated discount-rate regime plus a five-day divergence inside AI whose cause is not identifiable from prices alone. Any party or policy story must first control for these common factors.
